description:
ProSheets is a plugin for Autodesk Revit Add-in to batch export Views and Sheets to PDF, DWG, DGN, DWF, NWC, IFC, and Images (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, etc).


✔ New Features

Linked Models
- Export sheets and views from links - Pick what you need from any linked Revit model and export it together with the main model, without opening each model.
- Schedule them - Scheduled exports can include linked models, so the main model and its links export together, unattended.

Scheduling Assistant
- Open Revit - Scheduled exports now run even when Revit is closed, opening your model with the worksets you choose.
- Wake up your computer - A scheduled export can now wake your computer from sleep or hibernation, so it runs on time, even overnight.
- Publish cloud models - Scheduled exports to Forma can now also publish the cloud model, keeping it up to date for your whole team.

Localization
- Four new languages - ProSheets is now available in German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and Chinese (Simplified), following Revit's language by default.

DWG Export
- Combine views and sheets into DWG files - Export them to one DWG file, or to several grouped by a parameter, with each sheet as a layout.

Forma
- Support for Custom attributes parameter mapping - Map Revit sheet parameters to the custom attributes of the selected Forma project, so uploaded sheets carry your project data.

IFC Export
- Autodesk Open-source IFC exporter support - When Autodesk's open-source IFC exporter is installed, ProSheets exports with it and offers its IFC versions and saved setups.

Reports
- Custom report columns - Add sheet and view parameter columns to the Excel or CSV export report.

🚀 Enhancements

Scheduling Assistant
- Countdown, progress, and notifications - Before a scheduled run starts, you can cancel it, delay it 10 minutes, or start it now; a progress window lets you stop it, and a Windows notification reports the result.
- Simpler date and time picker - Pick the start date and time in one calendar.
- Exported files verified - Scheduled runs now check that each exported file was written, and the report flags any that are missing or empty.

DWG Export
- Portrait sheets stay portrait - Revit exports portrait sheets with a landscape layout; you can now turn on "Apply portrait layout correction" to keep them portrait.

General
- Profile compatibility check - Loading a profile now lists any settings that could not be applied and what was used instead, including in scheduled runs.
- Import several profiles at once - When creating a profile, "Import from file(s)" now accepts several files and creates one profile per file.

Reports
- Clearer export report - The Excel and CSV report now colors each status and uses the same language as ProSheets.

Selection Tab
- Consistent selection and search - Choosing a View/Sheet Set now filters the list instead of selecting its sheets. Select-all acts only on visible rows, and every search box has a clear (X) button.

IFC Export
- Ceiling grid and facility type options - In Revit 2025 and newer, use "Export Ceiling Grids" and, for IFC4x3, "Facility Type" and "Facility Predefined Type".

NWC Export
- Type and custom property options - "Type properties on Elements" and "Separate Custom properties" are now available for NWC exports.

🐛 Bug Fixes

PDF Export
- Fixed PDFs combined by View/Sheet Set silently leaving out selected sheets that aren't in a selected set; they now go to "Ungrouped".
- Fixed Revit Native PDFs using a different paper size from Revit's own PDF export.
- Fixed the table of contents of combined PDFs from PDF24 or another printer listing sheets alphabetically instead of in export order.
- Fixed pages after the first being rotated 180° in combined A3 PDFs printed with PDF24.
- Fixed Revit Native using the wrong paper size when a Windows printer form name contains "A0".

IFC Export
- Fixed Revit 2025 crashing when exporting IFC with linked files and "Export only elements visible in view" turned on.
- Fixed In-Session IFC exports ignoring the "Space boundaries" setting and, in Revit 2027, the "Export base quantities" setting.

NWC Export
- Fixed NWC exports not finishing, or producing much larger files, when Windows uses a regional number format such as French or German.

DWG Export
- Fixed "Bind Images as OLE in DWG File" not working when Civil 3D is the only AutoCAD-based product installed.
- Fixed dimension values changing when moved in DWG files exported with an export setup whose units are set to Default.

Selection Tab
- Fixed "Show only open sheets/views" leaving out open sheets that have an activated viewport.
- Fixed custom file names keeping a parameter's prefix, suffix, or separator when its value is empty.

Create Tab
- Fixed the export result not reporting a failure when only some files failed.
- Fixed the export report leaving out XML exports and linked models exported with "Export as separate IFCs". Those linked IFC files are now also uploaded to Forma.
- Fixed selected sheets taking several seconds to appear in the Create tab for free users on the first launch in a Revit session.
- Fixed image exports showing "IMAGE" instead of the image format, such as PNG or JPG.

Scheduling Assistant
- Fixed one-time schedules being saved with a start time in the past and never running.
- Fixed schedules showing as up to date after their local or Forma destination changed.
- Fixed scheduled export reports leaving the Forma path empty.

Forma
- Fixed a subfolder picked in the right-hand list of the Forma folder window being replaced by its parent folder.

General
- Fixed exports from two Revit sessions running at the same time deleting each other's files.
- Fixed ProSheets closing without a message after an error, for example while switching tabs.
- Fixed sheets that share a Sheet Number and Sheet Name, such as in different Sheet Collections, failing to export.
- Fixed exports failing to network folders whose security policy blocks files without an extension.
- Fixed French print options that said Temporary Hide/Isolate would be exited when it stays on, and English and French labels that didn't match Revit's terms, such as "Structural Plan".
- Fixed F1 on the ProSheets ribbon button opening the DiRoots website instead of the user guide.
